_comment: Shared scan-normalization vectors (S1 backend, S2 frontend). 'piece' = ScanInputNormalizer.normalizePiece(input). 'tracking' = TrackingNumberNormalizer.normalize(input) (null = rejected); a vector without 'tracking' does not assert it. 'productNumber' (B7, bazar price-sheet numbers) = ScanInputNormalizer.productNumber(input) / the phone's productNumber(input) (null = not a product number); a vector without it does not assert it.
